title.narrative: Punjab Climate-Resilient and Low-Carbon Agriculture Mechanization Project

description.narrative: The proposed project will support the just transition to a climate-resilient and low-carbon agriculture. This is to mitigate climate change, improve air quality and enhance agriculture productivity, sustainability and resilience. It will underpin Asian Development Bank (ADB)'s value addition and innovative approach to supporting food security in Punjab.
